channel.title: Resorts on YumFam
channel.description: Recent content in Resorts on YumFam

item.title: Puyuan Fashion Ancient Town — ¥499 (≈$70): Fujin Hotel Night + Breakfast + Ancient Town Entry & Autumn Art Events
item.description:
Deal price: ¥499 (≈$70, was ¥670) · ⏰ Valid through at least Dec 20, 2026 · ⏰ No surcharge on weekends or public holidays

Puyuan Fashion Ancient Town in Tongxiang, Jiaxing is running its autumn “Puyuan Weaves Autumn” program (Oct 15–Dec 20): the whole town becomes an open-air art exhibition — tea ceremonies, calligraphy, meditation, 30+ live performances a day, plus the CPOP WAVE 2026 pop-culture expo (Nov 2–8) with big-name game and animation IPs. This bundle pairs a night at the Fujin Hotel with breakfast, 2 adult ancient-town tickets, the art exhibitions, and free sightseeing shuttle rides around the town.

item.title: Guangzhou Phoenix City Hotel ¥499 (≈$70): 1 Night + Breakfast & Dinner for 2 Adults + 1 Kid, No Weekend Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: ¥499 (≈$70, was ¥1088, about 54% off) · ⏰ Valid Sep 11–Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ No surcharge on weekends, Mid-Autumn Festival or National Day · ⏰ Refundable if unreserved

Inside the Phoenix City (凤凰城) community in Zengcheng, Guangzhou — a garden-style resort hotel next to the Science City area — the Phoenix City Hotel is offering a straightforward family bundle: 1 night in a premium double/twin room, buffet breakfast for 2 adults + 1 kid (under 1.2m), and dinner for 2 adults + 1 kid at either the Vienna western restaurant or the Chinese restaurant. During the stay you also get the indoor swimming pool, the kids’ building-block play zone, and the kids’ water park.

item.title: Qingdao Movie Metropolis DoubleTree from ¥449 (≈$63): 1 Night + Breakfast + Kids' Park or Hotpot Dinner
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥449 (≈$63, was ¥988, about 55% off) · ⏰ Valid through Oct 31, 2026 — only 9 days left · ⏰ Refundable if unreserved

In Qingdao’s Huangdao district, next to the Oriental Movie Metropolis, the DoubleTree by Hilton is running an eat-stay-play bundle: 1 night in a deluxe room (king or twin) with breakfast for two, plus one of five add-on options — from kids’ park tickets to a hotpot dinner. Every stay also includes the famous warm DoubleTree cookie, plus free pool, gym and WiFi during the stay.

item.title: Zhangzhou Hot Spring Villa Resort ¥499 (≈$70): 1 Night + Meals + Hot Springs, Flower Expo & Snail Village
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥499 (≈$70, was ¥798, about 37% off) · ⏰ Buy now, valid for use Nov 1–30, 2026 · ⏰ Refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

In Zhangpu county, Zhangzhou, Fujian, the Southeast Flower Capital Hot Spring Hotel sits next to the Flower Expo park — an autumn family trip that bundles a villa-style stay with hot springs and two parks. Every package includes 1 night, buffet breakfast for 2 adults + 1 kid (under 1.4m), a kids’ set meal or wellness set meal (pick one), hot-spring entry for 2A1C, Flower Expo tickets for 2A1C, and Snail Village tickets for 2A1C.

item.title: Anji Moroccan-Style Art Resort ¥399 (≈$56): 2-Day Unlimited Elf Hill Tickets + Breakfast
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥399 (≈$56, was ¥999, about 60% off) · 2-night bundle ¥629 − ¥30 coupon = ¥599 · ⏰ 1-week flash sale · Valid through Jan 31, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

Inside Anji’s Hele Valley resort zone — between the Bamboo Museum and Lingfeng Mountain, 1.5h from Hangzhou and 2h from Shanghai — the Xingcheng Moroccan-Style Art Resort trades the usual bamboo aesthetic for something completely different: a high-design, gallery-like hotel wrapped in Moroccan romance. The bundle pairs the stay with 2 Elf Hill tickets with 2-day unlimited re-entry and daily breakfast for 2 adults + 1 kid, plus the valley’s activity program.

item.title: Wuhan Kaiyuan Senbo Resort ¥599 (≈$84): Garden-View Room + Water Park or Fantasy Island Tickets
item.description:
Deal price: Superior garden-view room, 1 night — ¥599 (≈$84, was ¥1,298, about 54% off) · Valid through Mar 31, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

Rising on a peninsula in Houguan Lake, the Wuhan Kaiyuan Senbo Resort is a ¥2.2-billion, 128,000㎡ all-season family resort — and this Double-11 bundle is its strongest value yet. One price covers a superior garden-view room, breakfast for two, your choice of 2 indoor-water-park or 2 Fantasy Island tickets, and a Yiqi travel-photography session. Weekends carry no surcharge through the whole validity period.

item.title: Xiamen Baixiang Portman Seven Star Bay ¥899 (≈$126): 2 Nights + Buffet Dinner & Breakfast
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥899 (≈$126, was ¥2,399, about 63% off) · Headline 2-night bundle ¥1,299 · Valid through Apr 30, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

“Apart from the price, there’s nothing wrong with it” — that’s the running verdict on the Xiamen Baixiang Portman, and at these Double-11 rates the price objection mostly evaporates. The resort does palace-scale grandeur properly: manicured grounds, a proper beach within reach, and service reviewers call out by name. The headline bundle covers 2 nights in a superior room, a weekday buffet dinner for two, daily buffet breakfast, and 2 mini-club activities for the kids. Autumn holidays and weekends carry no surcharge.

item.title: Xiamen Haiyue Shanzhuang ¥899 (≈$126): Family Mountain-View Twin Room + Breakfast + Kids Activities
item.description:
Deal price: Family mountain-view twin room, 1 night — ¥899 (≈$126, was ¥1,488, about 40% off) · Valid through Apr 30, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

Set in landscaped gardens on Huandao South Road — the back gate opens straight onto the beach — Haiyue Shanzhuang is the old-school Xiamen grande dame: state-guesthouse standards, Ming-Qing-style rooms in a bamboo courtyard, and grounds big enough to spend two days in. This family bundle covers a mountain-view twin room, breakfast for two plus a free kids’ breakfast (no height limit), a pony-cart or mini-train ride, and access to the dolphin park, indoor pool and afternoon tea. New Year holidays and weekends carry no surcharge.

item.title: Gubei Light Resort Beijing from ¥1,099 (≈$153): Gubei Water Town + Hot Spring + Great Wall Cableway
item.description:
Deal price: Superior room, 1 night — ¥1,099 (≈$153, was ¥1,550, about 29% off) · Valid Oct 22 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved

The Gubei Light Resort sits in the prime “C-position” of Gubei Water Town, the canal town beneath the Simatai Great Wall — and this package bundles the whole experience: 2 water-town scenic-area tickets, 2 hot-spring tickets, plus your choice of a Great Wall day or night tour with round-trip cableway or a dinner for two (3 options to pick from). Weekend stays are possible with a surcharge, so this works for a Saturday escape too.

item.title: Huian Julong Hot Spring Resort ¥488 (≈$68): Private Hot-Spring Room + Unlimited Soaking for 2 Adults & 2 Kids
item.description:
Deal price: Private hot-spring room, 1 night — ¥488 (≈$68, was ¥828, about 41% off) · Valid Sep 23 – Dec 30, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

Tucked inside the Julong eco-park in Huian, Quanzhou, the Julong Hot Spring Park Hotel pairs a private in-room hot-spring tub with unlimited access to the hot-spring park for your whole stay. This one-price package covers 2 adults + 2 kids (under 1.4m): breakfast, unlimited soaking, and the Pinecone Tribe kids’ play zone — plus a free shuttle and free parking. Weekends carry no surcharge.

item.title: Sanya Bay voco 2-Night Stay from ¥1,288 (≈$179): IHG Beachfront + Breakfast for 2 Adults & 2 Kids
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights, superior king/twin with balcony — ¥1,288 (≈$179, was ¥1,888, about 32% off) · Valid Aug 29 – Nov 30, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

voco Sanya Bay — the IHG brand’s easygoing beachfront address on Sanya Bay — is running an off-peak island escape: a balcony room for 2 nights, breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids (under 1.4m), a fresh-coconut welcome for two, first-day minibar, and a stack of on-property perks. Check-in is a relaxed 16:00, checkout noon.

item.title: Xiamen Langham Hotel from ¥699 (≈$97): 40㎡ Art-Hotel Room + Breakfast, No Weekend Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: Superior king/twin, 1 night + breakfast for two — ¥699 (≈$97, was ¥1,198, about 42% off) · Valid Oct 15 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

The Langham Hotel Xiamen — the Langham Hospitality Group’s art-forward address in Huli, steps from the Wanda Plaza shopping district — is on limited flash sale: a 40㎡ superior room with breakfast for two and free parking, and notably no weekend surcharge. Check-in 14:00, checkout noon.

item.title: Suzhou Jiletang Hot Spring Hotel — New Opening from ¥238 (≈$33): Room + Breakfast + 2 Hot-Spring Tickets, Zero Weekend Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast for two + 2 hot-spring tickets — ¥238 (≈$33, was ¥999, about 24% of list) · Valid May 21 – Oct 31, 2026 · zero weekend surcharge · ⏰ refundable if unreserved

The brand-new Jiletang Hot Spring Hotel (No. 999 Yangshan Ring Road, Huqiu District, Suzhou) bundles its opening promo the way families actually want it: a room, breakfast for two, and 2 hot-spring tickets per night covering the outdoor thermal pools, the water park, plus free fruit and drinks. Everything is new, the promo price is the draw — and weekends cost nothing extra.

item.title: Nanjing Wolonghu Lakeside Resort 2 Nights ¥499 (≈$70): 70㎡ Room, Water Play + Sauna Passes
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights in a 70㎡+ room + breakfast for 2 + water-play & sauna passes for 2 + lakeside cycling — ¥499 (≈$70, was ¥799, 38% of list) · Valid Oct 14, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · usable any day of the week, no weekend surcharge

On Wolonghu Avenue in Nanjing’s Lishui district, this lakeside resort sells space: the 72㎡ deluxe king (2 m bed) or 70㎡ twin, each with breakfast for two, a water-play pass for two — indoor surfing, a flower-sea photo zone, indoor pool, fish-therapy spa and sauna, plus KTV and board-game rooms — and lakeside cycling. Kids under 12 go free; ages 12–16 are ¥29.9 and 16+ ¥39.9.

item.title: Guangzhou Sunac Huajiantang Yuexue — Unlimited Snow-Play Stay from ¥699 (≈$97)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night in a city-view room + unlimited snow play — ¥699 (≈$97) (was ¥1000, about 70% of list) · Bookable through Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Snow in Guangzhou, minus the flight to Harbin. The Sunac Huajiantang Yuexue in Huadu pairs a night’s stay with unlimited-time snow play at the Sunac indoor snow park (热雪奇迹) next door — build snowmen, sled, and just play in real snow all day, or go for the unlimited beginner ski package if you want to learn.

item.title: Xiamen Portman Seven Star Bay — 2 Nights ¥999 (≈$139): Seaview Room, Breakfast + Kids' Club + Amusement Park
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights in an upper-floor seaview room — ¥999 (≈$139) (was ¥2399, about 42% of list) · Bookable through Apr 30, 2027 · ⏰ valid through Apr 30, 2027

One of Xiamen’s top-ranked family resorts (全国亲子度假酒店TOP100), the Portman Seven Star Bay sits in Tong’an with the sea right across the road. This Double 11 promo bundles 2 nights in an upper-floor seaview room with daily breakfast for two, plus five extra perks: 2 mini-club activity tickets, unlimited Seven Star Park trampoline/playground access, a professional photo-shoot experience for the family, and two more goodie experiences.

item.title: Beijing Xiangshan Family Hotel — 2-Night All-Inclusive Package ¥1,098 (≈$155), was ¥3,936
item.description:
Deal price: family play package, 1 night — ¥599 (≈$85) (was ¥1,896, 32% of list) · All-inclusive, 2 nights — ¥1,098 (≈$155) (was ¥3,936) · Valid Aug 20 – Dec 31, 2026 · usable any day of the week

Right by Xiangshan (Fragrant Hills) in Haidian, this is the autumn trip Beijing families book: the red-foliage season comes with zero weekend surcharge, and the 2-night all-inclusive package covers a Hollywood-themed family room, breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child each night, unlimited water-park play (09:00–21:00), a light meal for two, 3 tickets to the National Botanical Garden (~10 min drive), and the on-site petting park.

item.title: Gubei Water Town Inn Stay from ¥439 (≈$62) — 1 Night + Scenic Tickets + Hot-Spring Baths + Breakfast
item.description:
Deal price: inn room, 1 night — ¥439 (≈$62) (was ¥529) · Family room inn, 1 night — ¥799 (≈$113) (was ¥948) · Valid Sep 11, 2026 – Dec 31, 2026 · usable any day of the week

A night inside Gubei Water Town, the canal-laced old-town replica at the foot of the Simatai Great Wall in Miyun, Beijing. The inn package bundles one night with scenic-area tickets (multiple entries during your stay), unlimited rides on the in-town shuttle, access to the hot-spring bathhouses open in the scenic area, and breakfast — a genuinely good all-in-one deal for a water-town getaway.

item.title: Qiandaohu 4-Night Lakeside Stay ¥698 (≈$98) — Daily Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner Included
item.description:
Deal price: mountain-view room, 4 nights with 3 meals/day — ¥698 (≈$98) · 3 nights ¥598 (≈$85) · 2 nights ¥498 (≈$70) · 1 night ¥249 (≈$35) (63% of list) · Valid Sep 1, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · usable any day of the week, no weekend surcharge

A slow-travel deal on Qiandaohu (Thousand-Island Lake) in Chun’an: the Lichen Ruixuan sits in the central lake resort area, a short walk from the night-cruise pier and the fish-street food quarter. Every package includes daily breakfast, lunch and dinner for two, free parking, the gym, laundry room, kids’ playground and a games room.

item.title: Guangzhou Santori Hot Spring Manor — 'Little Greece' Waterfront Resort: Hot-Spring Room with Private Terrace Pool + Meals ¥598 (≈$84)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + meals + pools — ¥598 (≈$84) (was ¥1,200, 50% off) · Buy-and-use, refundable if unreserved · Autumn promo, currently on sale

Nicknamed “Guangzhou’s Little Greece,” the Santori Hot Spring Manor （圣托利温泉庄园， 112 Wenquan East Road, Conghua) is a romantic waterfront resort built around a rare natural soda hot spring （珍稀苏打原汤真温泉）. The autumn promo bundles a lot into one price: a hot-spring room with its own private terrace soaking pool, buffet breakfast and dinner for two, plus the infinity pool and a kids’ splash pool.

item.title: Hui'an Longgu Shanfang Hot Spring Suite — ¥488 (≈$69) for 2 Adults + 2 Kids, was ¥988
item.description:
Deal price: hot-spring suite, 1 night — ¥488 (≈$69) (was ¥988, 50% off) · Bookable Sep 23 – Dec 30, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 30, 2026 · no surcharge on weekends

Longgu Shanfang （惠安龙谷山房， south of Longgu Shanfang, Hui’an County, Quanzhou) is a forest hot-spring retreat that bundles everything a family day needs into one voucher: soak, play and eat without leaving the property.

item.title: Xiamen Sujia Puyue Private Hot-Spring Villa — 3BR from ¥588 (≈$83), was ¥1,588
item.description:
Deal price: private hot-spring 3BR villa — from ¥588 (≈$83) (was ¥1,588, 38% off) · Bookable Sep 3 – Oct 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

Sujia Puyue （宿家·璞悦温泉民宿， 2-4 Xinzhen Road, Xiang’an, Xiamen) is a hot-spring villa stay built for group getaways: each standalone villa sleeps a whole family (or several) with its own private hot-spring pool, plus entertainment rooms downstairs. Every package includes free Wi-Fi, free parking and a hanfu dress-up experience.

item.title: Zhangzhou Baixiang Yuanshan Hot Spring Hotel — Family Room from ¥799 (≈$113), was ¥1,999
item.description:
Deal price: family/kids room, 1 night — from ¥799 (≈$113) (was ¥1,999, 40% off) · Bookable Jan 8 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Baixiang Yuanshan Hotel （漳州佰翔圆山酒店， 1 Daqiao Road, Xiangcheng, Zhangzhou) — voted a 2025 Fujian Top-20 family resort hotel — pairs big 65㎡+ family rooms with a 30,000㎡ ancient-seawater hot-spring complex, so you can soak, eat and explore the old town in one trip.

item.title: Jiaxing Kaiyuan Senbo Resort — 1-Night Terrace Room from ¥818 (≈$115) with Water Park & Kids' Club
item.description:
Deal price: 1-night Terrace Room — from ¥818 (≈$115) (was ¥1,398, 59% off) · Bookable Aug 21 – Oct 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

Kaiyuan Senbo Resort （开元森泊度假乐园， 1677 Ganpu Avenue, Haiyan, Jiaxing) is a national Top-100 family resort hotel built around water and play: a 31,000㎡ indoor-outdoor water park (the indoor part open year-round) plus Fantasy Island （幻想岛）, a 2,300㎡ indoor children’s playground. Every package includes breakfast for 2 at the Cave Restaurant （岩洞餐厅）, 2 park tickets of your choice (two parks to choose from), a handicraft workshop (pick 1 of 3), a 屹奇 travel photo shoot, welcome fruit, and day-1 minibar drinks.

item.title: Taihu Longemont Resort — 1-Night Stay from ¥629 (≈$89) at Your Choice of 3 Themed Hotels + 2 Park Tickets
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + 2 park tickets — from ¥629 (≈$89) (was ¥1,298, 49% off) · Bookable Sep 14 – Dec 31, 2026, any day · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

One of China’s largest family resorts, Taihu Longemont （太湖龙之梦， Taihu resort area, Changxing, Huzhou) lets you choose your hotel — 动物世界大酒店 (Animal World Hotel), 钻石酒店 (Diamond Hotel), or 古镇大酒店 (Ancient Town Hotel) — and pick 2 park tickets from three options: the Animal World walk-through zone, the Ice & Snow Town, or the Performance City （演艺城）. A national Top-100 family resort hotel.

item.title: Qiyun Mountain Resort Hotel — 2 Nights + Scenic Tickets, Bamboo Raft & Night Show, from ¥839 (≈$118)
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights + 2-person scenic combo for ¥839 (≈$118) (was ¥1,199) · Bookable Sep 16 – Dec 31, 2026, no weekend surcharge · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Qiyun Mountain （齐云山， Xiuning County, Huangshan) is in peak autumn sea-of-clouds season, and the resort hotel is running its “shaiqiu” (晒秋） harvest-season promo: no surcharge on weekends, plus a free room upgrade on non-holiday stays (mention it when booking).

item.title: Yangzhou Slender West Lake Huijing Hotel — 2 Nights + 3 Buffet Meals a Day, from ¥579 (≈$82)
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights + daily buffet breakfast, lunch & dinner for two — ¥579 (≈$82) (was ¥399/night) · Bookable Oct 10 – Dec 31, 2026, any day of the week · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

This is the “livestream special” we’ve been waiting for in Yangzhou: the Slender West Lake Huijing Hotel （瘦西湖汇璟酒店） sits at the foot of Daming Temple right next to the 5A-rated Slender West Lake scenic area. Two nights in an elegant comfort room (28㎡, king or twin) with three buffet meals a day — breakfast, lunch and dinner — plus a free ride between the hotel and Yangzhou / Yangzhou East train station or the scenic area itself.

item.title: Zhangzhou Jiulongshuizhen — Ancient Hot-Spring Wellness Grand Opening, from ¥89 (≈$13)
item.description:
Deal price: kid’s hot-spring ticket + hot-spring egg + perilla drink — ¥89 (≈$13) (was ¥199, 4.5折） · Bookable Sep 24 – Dec 30, 2026, weekdays · ⏰ valid through Dec 30, 2026

A brand-new hot-spring opening near Xiamen: the Jiulongshuizhen Resort’s Ancient Hot-Spring Wellness Center （漳州九龙水镇度假区， 666 Taikouzhai, Hua’an County — about 40 minutes from Xiamen North station) leans into Song-dynasty aesthetics — ancient-style pools, fish therapy, herbal foot soaks, costume dress-up for photos, and a “Song-style Fujian meal” （宋风闽味） on the higher tiers.

item.title: Hangzhou Tianmu Dusit Thani — 50㎡ Garden-View Room + Private Hot-Spring Soak, ¥599 (≈$84)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast + private hot-spring soak — from ¥599 (≈$84) (was ¥1,999, 30% of list) · Bookable daily Oct–Dec 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

An autumn hot-spring escape in the bamboo forests of Tianmu Mountain, about 60 minutes from downtown Hangzhou. Dusit Thani’s Thai-hospitality property pairs a spacious 50㎡ garden-view twin room with balcony and daily breakfast for two with a 30-minute private outdoor wellness hot-spring soak — autumn in the mountains, steaming water, nobody queuing behind you.

item.title: Beijing Minmetals Narada (Xishan) — 6th Anniversary Family Package from ¥799 (≈$111)
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥799 (≈$111) (was ¥1,688 — over 50% off) · Anniversary gift pack included · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Beijing Minmetals Narada is celebrating its 6th anniversary with a family-loaded package: 1 night in a Junlan Xishan room with breakfast for two, plus a gift pack of 2 single-session Super Wings (超级飞侠) Land tickets, 2 kids’ buffet dinner tickets and an extra-bed coupon. (Note: this is the Xishan property, not the Fangshan Narada hot spring resort also on this site.)
